title: Non-operational EMP testing at SAMSO and Hill AFB
place_text: San Bernardino; Hill Air Force Base, Utah

tellings.quote: of uh testing that was done uh on our kind of equipment, but it was done at a base like um uh Space Missile Systems Organization in uh San Bernardino Hill Air Force Base in Utah,

related.note: Both are about EMP testing on missile equipment as an explanation for the shutdowns. The WSJ account says an EMP was wheeled up to Malmstrom itself; Salas says such testing was done only at SAMSO and Hill AFB, not at operational bases.

plain: Tests of how an electromagnetic pulse (EMP, a burst of energy that can knock out electronics) affects missile equipment were carried out, the claim goes, not at working missile bases but at the Space and Missile Systems Organization in San Bernardino and at Hill Air Force Base in Utah. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who says a UFO shut down the nuclear missiles in his care, says this on the show and connects it to a book called The Faded Giant and to a man named James Clattz. He raises it to argue that such testing would not explain the shutdowns he describes.
